answer: NovaOps's equipment policy states that personal laptops are not allowed for employees, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. All equipment remains NovaOps property and must be returned through IT at offboarding or role change​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops].

During the five-business-day IT continuity exception, IT must approve and log the use of a personal laptop before you can use it, even for those days. You cannot just go ahead without their approval and logging​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops].
The equipment policy is owned by IT, effective 2026-06-01​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § (whole document)].
